create_gamepad_instance: create a Gamepad instance to read from a Logitech F710 gamepad with custom velocity scales
run_gamepad_read_loop: run the gamepad read loop in a background thread to continuously poll HID device data
get_gamepad_command: get the current gamepad command as a numpy array with vx, vy, and wz velocity components
stop_gamepad: stop the gamepad read loop by setting is_running to False
interpolate_gamepad_value: interpolate a raw gamepad value with a custom scale and deadzone threshold
